prompts.light: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a NEW premium but playful DearBody Philippines perfume launch campaign photograph. Reference images show the exact six real bottles, preserve bottle shapes, rounded shoulders, thick clear bases, tall black caps, original label typography and logos, proportions and liquid colors precisely. First photo: Mistened Narcissus ivory label faint clear liquid; Mojito Metallique ivory label golden liquid; Amber Oud Silk ivory label pale amber. Second: Charme Envoûtant black label orange amber liquid; Rtulle & Satin black label pale turquoise; Oud Mirage black label pale blue lilac. Arrange ALL SIX bottles standing upright at varied heights across a warm architectural studio of broad stepped plinths. New composition, graphic sculptural sunlit cream plaster steps, one burnt orange cylindrical plinth, a large burgundy architectural circular opening in background, a subtle warm gold reflected plane. Refined lively art direction with dimensional shadows and physical materials. Wide 16:9 canvas about 1800x1000. Bottles all in central 75% of width and central 65% of height to support a mobile crop; all six complete and clearly visible separated, no overlap of labels. Camera just slightly below bottle height, frontal labels clear. Luxurious golden daylight, airy warm cream environment. No extra bottles, no boxes, no graphic text, no baked-in advertising text, no added logos, no fruit props, no floral props, no blur obscuring bottles. Exact text on labels as reference; Rtulle spelling starts R, Envoûtant circumflex. This is Light art direction. Keep original packaging perfectly identical. Output one polished photograph.
prompts.dark: Use case: lighting-weather. Edit the first reference image (the newly created six-product studio campaign) to create the DearBody DARK art direction. KEEP ALL SIX BOTTLES IDENTICAL: exact pixel-like geometry, original label print, black caps, liquid colors, positions, size, glass brightness and material. Keep the same 16:9 composition and architectural universe. Change ONLY the environment/lighting: steps and background become layered deep warm burgundy (#5C0006 and darker #2b080e), cylinder remains rich burnt-orange, circular opening filled with warm amber light, warm rim illumination and controlled deep dimensional shadows. Broad burgundy surfaces, understated warm gold reflected light; intimate immersive premium editorial mood, still welcoming playful. Bottles remain bright and legible, no recoloring packaging or tinting glass liquids. No pure black environment, no cold grey, no blue lighting, no nightclub, no metallic gold decoration, no additional text or logo. Six exact fragrance names must remain Mojito Metallique, Mistened Narcissus, Amber Oud Silk, Charme Envoûtant, Rtulle & Satin, Oud Mirage. Output only the new dark photograph.
prompts.mobile_light: Use case: ads-marketing. Create the MOBILE 4:5 portrait companion of this exact six-bottle DearBody photograph. Recompose ONLY: same six bottles preserved, same labels typography logo caps proportions glass liquid colors, same sunlit cream architectural stepped-plinth studio burgundy circular opening burnt orange cylinder. Arrange the six complete bottles with readable frontal labels on three staggered tiers (two per tier), balanced close group with enough breathing room above and all base edges visible. Keep all six bottle sizes physically consistent; no larger giant bottles. Bright golden daylight, no extra text, no logos added. Output 4:5 portrait 1120x1400. Product packaging must remain identical to reference. Label text exact MISTENED NARCISSUS, MOJITO METALLIQUE, AMBER OUD SILK on ivory; CHARME ENVOÛTANT, RTULLE & SATIN, OUD MIRAGE on black.
prompts.mobile_dark: Use case: lighting-weather. Create DARK version of this exact 4:5 mobile six-bottle campaign. Change ONLY environment and lighting; preserve each of six bottle silhouettes, caps, liquid colors, print and logos, exact positions/sizes. Same architectural stepped arrangement. All cream steps and cream wall become rich deep burgundy warm red, circular opening amber illuminated, burnt orange cylinder, atmospheric yet inviting warm rim light. Product labels and glass remain bright readable, no tinting liquid, no changing bottle geometry. All six complete. No cold gray/black nightclub lighting, no gold decoration, no added text. Keep precise MISTENED NARCISSUS, MOJITO METALLIQUE, AMBER OUD SILK, CHARME ENVOÛTANT, RTULLE & SATIN, OUD MIRAGE. 1120x1400 4:5 portrait.
